title: Synthetic example — weekly 'follow' clicks drop after a logging-spec release
symptom: The weekly report shows follow-click users -6% and follow events -9% week over week (weekly daily means). Establish whether this is a real decline or an aggregation problem, and what happened.

answer.summary: Part of the drop is an artifact: an action added in logging spec v5 was missing from the batch aggregation's action list, so it was silently undercounted. The real change is smaller and in line with the whole reaction family; the per-user decline matches the feed layout update.

rubric.check: Rebuilt the reported numbers and found the gap between the report snapshot and the current mart
Identified the new, unmapped action as the source of the gap
Separated users, events and per-user intensity
Compared against the other reaction metrics as a control

should_not.claim: The whole drop is a real behavior decline
Rejects the logging change because the action 'never existed'

calendar.summary: Client logging spec v5 rollout (app 3.1, iOS/Android)
